# Go Do

> Go Do (go-do.live) is a free app and website that lists every event and activity in Utah — concerts, games, festivals, theater, family events, classes, community events and outdoor activities — in one feed, soonest first, and helps people make plans with friends. Operated by Go Do, LLC.

## Key pages
- [What is Go Do?](https://go-do.live/what-is-go-do/): what Go Do is, how it started, and its purpose
- [Things to do in Utah this week](https://go-do.live/things-to-do/): upcoming events by day, city and category
- [This weekend in Utah](https://go-do.live/things-to-do/this-weekend/) and [free things to do this week](https://go-do.live/things-to-do/free/)
- [Activities in Utah](https://go-do.live/activities/): things to do any time (hikes, hot springs, museums, climbing gyms…) by kind (e.g. https://go-do.live/activities/hot-springs/) and by city (e.g. https://go-do.live/activities/in/provo/)
- [How to install](https://go-do.live/how-to-install/): add Go Do to an iPhone or Android Home Screen
- [Advertise](https://go-do.live/advertisers/), [Data feed for partners](https://go-do.live/data-feed/), [AI agents](https://go-do.live/ai-agents/)

## Listing pages
- Each event has a page at https://go-do.live/event/{id}/ with schema.org Event data
- Each activity has a page at https://go-do.live/activity/{id}/ with schema.org place data (address, hours, cost)

## For AI assistants
- MCP server with "Sign in with Go Do" (OAuth): https://mcp.go-do.live/mcp
- Public search without an account: https://mcp.go-do.live/mcp/public
- OpenAPI (REST, for custom GPT actions): https://mcp.go-do.live/openapi.json
- Tools — search: search_events, search_activities, get_details. The member's account: my_profile, my_plans, my_invites (invites, get-togethers and pings waiting on their answer), replies (how friends answered their pings and plans), plan_details, friends_going, list_friends (friends and groups). With changes allowed, only when the member asks: set_plan (Going / Maybe / Can't go), send_ping ("Should we go?" to friends or groups), plan_with_friends (one day = set; two to six = friends pick), answer_invite, answer_ping.
- Words: events happen on a date; activities can be done any time (call them activities, not places). The person who sets up a plan is the organizer. A ping is a light "Should we go?"; a plan invite asks friends to a day (or a few to pick from). Dates and times are Utah (Mountain) time.
- Setup steps for Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, Perplexity and Le Chat: https://go-do.live/ai-agents/

## Using Go Do's listings
- Assistants are welcome to search Go Do for a person who asked (the MCP server and pages above) and to link people to go-do.live.
- Go Do's listings may not be bulk-downloaded, republished, resold or used to train AI models (Terms & Conditions, section 10).
